subject: receipts from visit
body:
Dear Vince,

Thanks again for taking the time to visit. Both faculty and students got a lot out of your presentations.

I have a favor to ask concerning the expense reimbursement process. Can you mail all travel and lodging receipts to my secretary Joan Payne at the following address:

Joan Payne
Department of Finance
2163 CEBA
Louisiana State University
Baton Rouge, LA 70803

Thanks,

Jim Garven
